From ca1f4d702d534387aa1f16379edb3b03cdb6ceda Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sven Schnelle <svens@linux.ibm.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2021 16:08:18 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] s390: clear pt_regs::flags on irq entry

The current irq entry code doesn't initialize pt_regs::flags. On exit to
user mode arch_do_signal_or_restart() tests whether PIF_SYSCALL is set,
which might yield wrong results.

Fix this by clearing pt_regs::flags in the entry.S irq handler
code.

Reported-by: Heiko Carstens <hca@linux.ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: Sven Schnelle <svens@linux.ibm.com>
Reviewed-by: Heiko Carstens <hca@linux.ibm.com>
Fixes: 56e62a737028 ("s390: convert to generic entry")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org> # 5.12
Signed-off-by: Vasily Gorbik <gor@linux.ibm.com>

diff --git a/arch/s390/kernel/entry.S b/arch/s390/kernel/entry.S
index 9cc71ca9a88f..e84f495e7eb2 100644
--- a/arch/s390/kernel/entry.S
+++ b/arch/s390/kernel/entry.S
@@ -418,6 +418,7 @@ ENTRY(\name)
 	xgr	%r6,%r6
 	xgr	%r7,%r7
 	xgr	%r10,%r10
+	xc	__PT_FLAGS(8,%r11),__PT_FLAGS(%r11)
 	mvc	__PT_R8(64,%r11),__LC_SAVE_AREA_ASYNC
 	stmg	%r8,%r9,__PT_PSW(%r11)
 	tm	%r8,0x0001		# coming from user space?
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/s390/kernel/entry.S`**
   - A new line was added to the IRQ entry handler code:
     ```assembly
     xc	__PT_FLAGS(8,%r11),__PT_FLAGS(%r11)
     ```
   - This line clears the `pt_regs::flags` by using the `xc` (exclusive clear) instruction, ensuring that the flags are reset when entering an interrupt.

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a bug where the `pt_regs::flags` was not being initialized upon IRQ entry, which could lead to incorrect behavior in the `arch_do_signal_or_restart()` function when checking if `PIF_SYSCALL` is set. By clearing the flags in the IRQ handler, the patch ensures that the system state is correctly reset, preventing potential misinterpretations of the flags during user mode transitions. This change is crucial for maintaining the integrity of the interrupt handling mechanism on the s390 architecture.
